stage.note: Confirmed only that the company (originally LayerCI, rebranded webapp.io) went through YC S20, implying at least a pre-seed/YC investment. No priced seed/Series A round, amount, or investor list was found in YC's profile, the company's own blog, or HN discussion within the time budget; company was acquired by Harness (announced Feb 2025, platform shut down June 1, 2025) before any later round (if any) could be found, so stage is left unknown rather than guessed.

note: YC company page confirms webapp.io (YC S20, Toronto, founders Colin Chartier and Lyn Chen) is the same domain as the hinted YC directory entry, status 'Acquired'. Company blog (Colin Chartier, Feb 2025) confirms acquisition by Harness and that the webapp.io platform itself was shut down on June 1, 2025 even though the marketing/pricing site was still live as of this audit (2026-09-29/30) with stale pricing. Company was originally branded 'LayerCI' (same YC S20 batch/founders) before rebranding to webapp.io; footer credits 'Layer DevOps Inc.' as the legal entity. No funding amount, round type, or revenue figure could be confirmed or estimated from available sources in the time budget.
